title: Browser: Save / Save As downloads the FLA via browser download
description: In the web/browser build, File > Save and Save As should trigger a browser download of the .fla file. Check useFileActions.ts / Shell.tsx for where the Tauri save dialog / file write is called. In the browser fallback: serialize the document to FLA bytes via the existing saveFla() path, create a Blob, construct an object URL, create a temporary <a download=project.fla href=url> element, click it, then revoke the URL. For Save As, prompt for a filename first (window.prompt or a simple modal). The file should be named after the project or default to 'untitled.fla'.
